text:
jamie: Heads up — preflight eval (prompt set A) flagged a ~3% quality drop for summarizer outputs targeting the EU route. Need a quick triage and decision before the 11:00 UTC change window.

deploybot: [automated] Preflight-eval report: https://redwood.internal/evals/3150009876 — metric: ROUGE-L down 3.1% vs baseline. Trigger: quality-gate. Suggested actions: rollback-route, pin-version, or hotfix.

alex: 3% could be noise depending on sample. Is it concentrated on a particular prompt subset?

maria: ran a stratified split — degradation is concentrated on long-doc prompts (L>800 tokens). Short prompts look stable. Quick summary attached: 22/250 long-docs worsened, avg drop ~6%.

leo: Given that, my preference is targeted mitigation: route-level rollback for EU only to previous model v1.3.1, while keeping global rollout paused. That avoids global rollback and keeps other regions live.

product-sara: We need to reflect this in release notes: call out long-doc regression for EU, mitigation (route rollback), and planned follow-up (bisect + quant profile review). I can draft the blurb if we decide.

jamie: @deploybot — can you list compatible rollback actions and estimated time-to-serve for a route rollback? Also state if there are cache/warmup impacts.

deploybot: options:
- rollback-route --route eu --to v1.3.1 (estimated 4 min to drain + 8 min warmup)
- pin-model global --version v1.3.1 (drains all routes, ~12 min total)
- hotfix-quant (requires build + test, ~2-3 hours)
Note: route rollback will cause a short spike in cold-starts for batched workers in EU.

ben: SRE note — if we do route rollback, please throttle rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid capacity shocks. Also watch KV cache miss rate.

alex: If we can scope to EU only, thumbs up from me. We should open a bisect ticket and run focused evals on the long-doc subset asap.

maria: I'll kick off a quick bisect run and attach failing prompt IDs into the ticket.

jamie: OK consensus forming: staged rollback on EU route to v1.3.1 with throttled rollout. Product will update release notes with a mitigation note. Can we get explicit ACKs?

leo: ACK — I'll own the rollback and monitor metrics. Will follow ben's throttle plan.

product-sara: ACK — drafting release note now, will post for signoff.

ben: ACK — I'll standby for monitoring thresholds and can escalate to oncall if error rates or latency exceed thresholds.

deploybot: [action] Created ticket RE-5821: "EU route rollback to v1.3.1 after long-doc regression" — includes eval link and suggested throttle steps.

jamie: Thanks all. plan: leo triggers rollback at 10:45 UTC, product posts release note update by 10:50, maria runs bisect + posts results by 11:30. If any unexpected issues, we escalate on this thread. :thumbsup:
